meta.name: Amar Vishwas
meta.description: Amar Vishwas is a gripping legal drama about a fearless lawyer who believes that the law has value only when it protects the truly innocent. Shaped by a painful past, Amar has built his life around one unbreakable principal - if a person is innocent in reality, justice must be delivered, even if it means crossing boundries.

videos.title: Peedit Ya Gunahgar
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas enters a volatile murder trial, questioning flawed investigations and asserting that justice begins with doubt, not verdicts.

videos.title: Kahani Mein Twist
videos.overview: As a murder case unfolds, lawyer Amar Vishwas begins peeling back lies and hidden motives, discovering that the truth is far more dangerous than the crime itself.

videos.title: Naya Shaq
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas dismantles a staged narrative in court, exposing hidden motives and cracks in the prosecution as truth begins to tilt the case.

videos.title: Muqadme Mein Mod
videos.overview: As Amar Vishwas peels back lies in a fragile case, a hidden motive surfaces, testing his ethics and pushing the truth closer to a breaking point.

videos.title: Takat Banam Saboot
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas digs deeper into a fragile case, exposing cracks in witness stories as his ethics are tested by pressure and a risky courtroom move.

videos.title: Dabav Mein Insaaf
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas faces a crucial case where truth collides with power, forcing him to risk his career to protect an innocent life and uphold justice.

videos.title: Faisle Ke Baad
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas takes on a high-stakes case exposing power, betrayal and truth, forcing him to risk his career to save an innocent life. Legal drama.

videos.title: System Ke Khilaaf
videos.overview: When a buried truth resurfaces, lawyer Amar Vishwas risks his career to protect an innocent man, exposing power, betrayal and the cost of justice.

videos.title: Dabi Sacchai
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas battles lies and power in court as a hidden truth cracks the case wide open, pushing justice closer but raising the personal stakes.

videos.title: Katghare Mein Sach
videos.overview: Amar Vishwas takes on a high-stakes case as hidden motives surface, testing his faith in justice while the truth threatens powerful enemies. Ahead. Now.
